notes.title: HotFix 11.0
notes.content:
Here's what has been done for this fix as we slowly walk toward a better experience.

Some people seem to still experience some saving/loading issues which are now rare and very hard to fix as I can t reproduce them, so I invite you to contact me on the [url=https://discord.gg/vy7dJCyB7d]game's Discord[/url] and send me your save files ( locate there : C:\Users\ {your username} \AppData\LocalLow\Xavier Moiny\The Kind Camomille) via private message. 

[u]Fixes : [/u]

- Fixed an issue where staircases where not staying unlocked under some circumstances.
- Fixed some issues with the wrong dialogues being loaded in some circumstances for some characters when at the birthday table.
- Fixed multiple locations where Camomille could get stuck between rocks.
- Added a missing mention of an item given to you by Chef Marko upon completing his quest.
- Fixed multiple Typos
- Reworked part of the optimization code/technical tricks to still make the framerate better on lower end computers.

notes.title: HotFix 10.0
notes.content:
Things are getting better but all is not done! 
Here we go for today .

Thank you to everyone notifying me about their findings!

[u]Fixes.[/u]
- Fixed a weird collision issue where Camomille would float and slide in some situation around some bridges down Grandma's house.
- Fixed a weird collision issue by the sacks of flour.
- Fixed a weird collision issue by the magnifying glass.
- A missing pick up text for the Queen Bee shouldn't be missing anymore. 
- Trying a solution for the Achievements for the ending and the top of the world as it doesn t seem to work for everyone yet. 
- Reworked the Occlusion culling solution to help fixing some of the most important culling issue where massive chunks of the island would disappear.

notes.title: HotFix 9.0 - A small one.
notes.content:
Hi! 
Focused a bit on achievements and other back end things for this HotFix as well as some audio rework.

[b]Fixes : [/b]
- Fixed some achievements not triggering : Glider, Rod and Butterfly Net. The ending one also should work properly now.
- Fixed collision issues with the picnic table
- Music Tracks are Mastered and now in their final form.
- New sounds have been added ( like waterfalls)
- Fixed a very rare issue where Camomille would go through the floor of the Island when jumping for the top. (this has been reported once, and replicated once after 253 tries, still it s bad so I fixed it)

Not a big patch by any means but more to come soon!

Xavier

notes.title: HotFix 8.0 - A bit of everything.
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 
Here is today's patch list !

[b]Fixes :[/b]
- Goink's Request is now reactivated, it's achievement should work also. 
- Removed the *Press any Key to start* in loading screen, as pointed out by a backer, it s quite unnecessary. 
- Fixed a river/small waterfall animated texture going upward.
- Fixed a sign that was pointing to the Owl's village the wrong way
- Fixed a bug where the minimap player icon would should in camera when zoomed out.
- Tentatively tried a fix about the bad scaling of the different pop ups depending on screen resolutions (this one might work for a good percentage of people but still might be an issue for super wide screens) 
- Fixed some typos here and there. 
- Fixed A bug in the main menu that made the controller un-usable to launch a new game.

[b]Known bugs/missing features/Wishlist : [/b]
- Problem interfacing with the monument on keyboards (believe me, it's really dumb and trivial but yet I can't seem to find why it is not working, yet)
- Backpacks and custom colors not yet saving
- Achievements might still be buggy here and there.
- M/Select to open Map
- A way to shift quickly between items.
- Fully scalable UI.

Thank you for your patience everyone.

notes.title: Second Day - Patch Fever V5.0
notes.content:
This one should help a lot, if it works as well as tested. 
Thank you again for everyone's help and feedback.

Note : It is possible that even after the game being patched your save might have some issues. The nature of the initial bug made duplicates of the data inside the binary save file. I tried to find a way to fix save files in an automatic manner but the issue is too random.

I am sorry for that inconvenience.

[b]Fixes : [/b]
[list]
[*] - Fixed a problem with the Saving functionality.
[*] - Fixed a problem with the Loading a save file after exiting the game.
[*] - Fixed a problem when NPCs would forget you helped them, even if you did, even if it was saved.
[*] - Doubled/Ghost menus pages should be a thing of the past. 
[*] - Dialogue overlaps should be a thing of the past (except around the birthday table, this is an other issue)
[*] - Pets now should walk back to Camomille after activating them in the menu. Working on a fix to keep them activated on Exit/Load
[*] - Fixed several font sizes that were going beyond the boxe's edges. 
[*] - Map was re-renderer to remove the weird yellow artifact by Mr Pelican's house.
[*] - End Credits are now skippable ( Yes i know, why was that even an issue!?)
[*] - Founder's monument is now working with gamepads and the Book's page are readable. The system is still being fixed for keyboard/mouse as it got really ugly under the hood and need a good overhaul.
[/list]

[b]Important Known Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] - Goink and Elf Quest is still broken, i deactivated it for the moment, should be fixed next patch!
[*] - Keyboard input not working with funder monument.
[*] - Achievments are not all working. Some are not saving properly
[*] - If your OS is in an other language than English the menus will be in your OS language but the texts are in English. It s a bug. [u]But you can fix it by heading to the option menu, picking your language and saving. [/u]
[*] - Pets movement/physics interpolation is wacky with high FPS
[*] - NPC's dialogue window are doubled around the table if you happen to be close to two of them a a time.
[/list]

[b]Quality of life things added to the todo list are : [/b]
[list]
[*] - M to open Map
[*] - Select to open Map
[*] - Saving Camomille's custom color choice
[*] - Player Position Indicator too small on Map
[*] - Remaping Controls ( that s gonna be last)
[/list]

And then the little collision bugs here and there. They are not forgotten.

notes.title: Release Day Patch Fever 3.0
notes.content:
Okay, that s a rocky launch to say the least. 
I suppose i didn t do a good job at testing everything by myself. 

Thanks to some players (Shoutout to def1nt especially) i am able to track and fix them faster.

Here are the current fixes : 

- Goink's request has been fixed
- The Geyzer and Walrus's quests were not saving properly, now they do.
- Removed M and map button from the controls schemes as they are not used ingame.
- Not really a fix but Fortune Teller has been deactivated for the moment as it's dialogue system doesn t seem to work for many people, she is supposed to guide you in helping the island residents, talking to her is not needed to complete the game.  Once she ll be fixed i ll reactivate her!

- A variety of sounds have been patched also.

- A known bug that i cannot reproduce yet seems to happen when talking to grandma and locking the game, don t despair i ll fix it! 

- It seems that updating the game deletes some achievements for some people. I am investigating as this is extremely weird and very bad.
